name: Vöhl (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, white and blue with a broad white middle stripe, charged below the centre with the municipal arms of Vöhl (a red church on white above a Hessian lion).
history: Municipal flag of Vöhl; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
